item.title: A look at the future of brain research funding, from a kids' camp for TBI survivors
item.description: A Pennsylvania summer camp helps children who have survived brain injuries. But the future of federal funding for brain injury research, and grants to states to help such patients, is in limbo.

item.title: Penn State bust put focus on cocaine but on most campuses the big risk is alcohol
item.description: A drug bust involving an alleged cocaine ring at Penn State has drawn attention to drug use on college campuses, but research shows the big risk to students is alcohol.
item.content:encoded: A drug bust involving an alleged cocaine ring at Penn State has drawn attention to drug use on college campuses, but research shows the big risk to students is alcohol.

item.title: High-intensity sprints can trigger molecular changes in the bloodstream
item.description: A new study finds that an all-out sprint may have unique benefits when it comes to the proteins and tiny molecules in your bloodstream.

item.title: Nonprofits are helping musicians pay for insurance in Austin, Texas, and beyond
item.description: A nonprofit and a local public health agency are subsidizing marketplace health insurance for Austin musicians , even as rising healthcare costs make the program more expensive.

item.title: Becerra, running for governor of California, faces a health insurance problem
item.description: The nation's uninsured rate hit a historical low when Xavier Becerra was health secretary. Now he wants to be California's next governor as Trump's actions have driven people off health insurance.

item.title: How to think about this summer's slate of food safety recalls
item.description: NPR's David Folkenflik talks with Don Schaffner, a food microbiology specialist and distinguished professor at Rutgers University, about this summer's foodborne illnesses and recalls.

item.title: As USS Lincoln heads home, mental health experts tally the stressors of life at sea
item.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln is now on its way home after spending nine months at sea. Experts weigh in on the mental health challenges of prolonged confinement and isolation aboard an aircraft carrier.

item.description: From state and local food-safety response to the federal health agencies that fund that work, a record-breaking year for cyclosporiasis cases runs up against the Trump administration's cuts last year.

item.title: What to know about Dr. Heidi Overton, Trump's pick to lead the FDA
item.description: Dr. Heidi Overton is currently working as a White House policy aide. If confirmed, she would lead an agency of 18,000 staffers who study and regulate food, drugs, medical devices, tobacco and more.

item.title: Which country makes the best jollof rice? D.C. foodies put it to a blind test
item.description: One of the most famous dishes across West Africa is jollof rice — fragrant rice cooked down with spices, tomatoes and meat. But which version is best? A traveling festival aims to find out.
